call_distributed_init: call distributed_init to initialize the process group for multi-GPU or TPU distributed training
call_call_main: call call_main to spawn distributed processes and run the main training function across GPUs
call_all_gather_list: call all_gather_list to gather arbitrary picklable Python data from all workers into a list
call_all_reduce_dict: call all_reduce_dict to all-reduce a dictionary of tensor and scalar values across workers
call_broadcast_object: call broadcast_object to broadcast an arbitrary Python object from one worker to all other workers
